ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.
